pages.text: The $(thing)Magma Crawler$() lives in the Magma Chambers' sea. Basaltic Magma is its water: it swims through it as fast as you walk, and its bite sets you alight. On dry rock it is slower.
The $(thing)Plume Elemental$() is a blob of mantle rock that convects. Deep down it heats and rises; high up it cools and sinks. Stand over or beside it and the upwelling throws you into the air.

The $(thing)Fission Husk$() glows with what decays inside it - stand near it and your dose climbs. Kill it and it splits: two lighter husks fly apart in a burst of neutrons, and each of those splits once more.

The $(thing)Geodynamo Wraith$() is a loop of the core's own current. It circles its prey; ferromagnetic armour near it is Magnetized and pulled in, and it can tear an iron tool out of your hand. Wear no iron near it.
